boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented JBU traditions and recurring activities, from the first-basket toilet-paper toss to hall-specific celebrations and orientation competitions.

cards.title: Let It Fly After the First Basket
cards.subtitle: Bill George Arena’s season-opening toilet-paper toss
cards.notes: Bring your blue-and-gold spirit, then wait for the Golden Eagles’ first home-schedule basket before joining the organized toss.
cards.short_summary: JBU’s opening home basket triggers a court-covering cascade and an automatic technical foul.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU states that fans annually throw several thousand toilet-paper rolls after the Golden Eagles score their first basket of the home schedule.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Held in connection with the first men's basketball home game; consult JBU Athletics for the current schedule and entry details.

cards.title: Light a Candle Before Finals
cards.subtitle: JBU’s Christmas-season service dating to 1942
cards.notes: Check the university calendar for the December service, arrive before it begins, and take part in the communal candle lighting.
cards.short_summary: Music, candlelight and the academic calendar converge in a longstanding pre-finals observance.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU documents an annual Candlelight Service held every December before finals week and says the tradition has continued since 1942.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: JBU invites students, employees, alumni and the Siloam Springs community; verify the current December date on the university calendar.

cards.title: Turn Lip-Syncing Into a Team Sport
cards.subtitle: A JBU student lip-sync competition running for over a decade
cards.notes: Form a student team, select a song and build a synchronized stage routine when Student Events & Activities announces registration.
cards.short_summary: Student teams compete through choreographed, theatrical performances of popular songs.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU describes Mock Rock as its lip-sync battle of more than ten years, with student teams performing popular songs for prizes.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Participation is described for student teams; consult Student Events & Activities for current registration and audience details.

cards.title: Answer Survey Questions, JBU Style
cards.subtitle: Student Events & Activities’ Family Feud-inspired contest
cards.notes: Watch for the Student Events & Activities announcement, gather a team and prepare for a friendly survey-answer showdown.
cards.short_summary: A familiar television-game format becomes a named campus competition organized for JBU students.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU identifies The Feud as a friendly competition hosted by Student Events & Activities and based on the Family Feud show.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Current timing, team eligibility and audience access are not stated on the source page; confirm with Student Events & Activities.

cards.title: Open the Week With More Than 50 Flags
cards.subtitle: A ceremony recognizing JBU students’ countries of origin
cards.notes: Attend the opening flag ceremony and use the week’s programming to learn directly about countries represented at JBU.
cards.short_summary: An annual procession of national flags centers the international backgrounds within the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says World Awareness Week begins with a flag ceremony displaying more than 50 flags representing students’ countries of origin.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: The source establishes annual recurrence but does not provide current dates or public-access terms; check JBU’s calendar.

cards.title: Start Orientation on a Bigger Team
cards.subtitle: Fall orientation’s team activities and obstacle games
cards.notes: Join your assigned orientation group, meet the larger team and follow event leaders through the scheduled challenges.
cards.short_summary: New students begin their JBU experience by combining orientation groups for playful team competition.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU states that Big Games occurs at the beginning of orientation week each fall, combining orientation groups into teams for activities and obstacles.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Presented as part of fall orientation; participation details should be taken from the current new-student orientation schedule.

cards.title: Represent Your Floor in Color
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Hall’s annual intramural-field paint event
cards.notes: Wear clothes suitable for washable paint, follow residence-life safety directions and stay within your floor’s assigned color.
cards.short_summary: Mayfield residents turn floor identity into a highly visible, color-coded outdoor competition.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU documents Mayfield Paint War as an annual event on the intramural fields where residence-hall floors receive assigned paint colors.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: This is a Mayfield Hall-specific event; residents should follow current Residence Life instructions, boundaries and clothing guidance.

cards.title: Trade Hutch Hill for a Golf Cart
cards.subtitle: Faculty rides and RA pancakes on the climb to class
cards.notes: Look for the designated golf carts before class or chapel, accept rides only from event drivers and pick up an RA pancake.
cards.short_summary: A steep campus walk becomes a residence-hall event involving faculty drivers and breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says Hutch Hall Hill Haul offers students golf-cart rides up Hutch Hill from faculty members, along with pancakes supplied by resident assistants.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: The source does not state a current date or participation rules; follow Hutch Hall and Residence Life announcements.

cards.title: Tour Christmas Suites in J. Alvin
cards.subtitle: An all-campus party built around decorated living areas
cards.notes: Enter through the J. Alvin atrium, tour the themed suite displays respectfully and cast a vote for a favorite design.
cards.short_summary: Residents transform suites into interactive Christmas environments for a campus-wide celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU describes the J. Alvin Christmas Party as open to the whole campus, with decorated suites, snacks, voting and a large Christmas tree.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: JBU calls the event open to all campus; current date, residence-hall entry procedures and guest policies require confirmation.

cards.title: Tie-Dye With a Root Beer Float
cards.subtitle: Walker Hall’s clothing-coloring neighbor event
cards.notes: Bring a clean white shirt, socks or another dye-ready item, then follow the event’s stations while meeting Walker neighbors.
cards.short_summary: Walker Hall pairs outdoor tie-dyeing with root beer floats in one distinctively named gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU documents Walker Hall’s Float or Dye as an event where attendees bring white clothing to tie-dye while drinking root beer floats.
cards.source_title: Student Traditions & Activities at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: The source frames this as a Walker Hall neighbor event; confirm current eligibility, timing and supplied materials with Residence Life.

warnings: The official traditions page does not provide current dates, prices or exact coordinates for these events; those fields remain unknown or null rather than inferred.
